test_intent: Verify that calling MarkUserOkay on a mock AI checks instance created by TK.CreateMockAiChecks does not throw an exception.
reason: Factory smoke test that only verifies a mock method doesn't throw. The MarkUserOkay method on a mock is a no-op by design and carries no production behavior. No distinct bot contract exists beyond verifying the test factory is constructible. Compile-time coverage already ensures the method signature is correct.

test_intent: Verify that RequireAiAnalysisEffect.ExecuteAsync delegates to IAiCascadeService.HandleAiCascadeAnalysisAsync with the correct message, user, ML score, and silent mode parameters.
reason: Clean unit test at the correct seam. Verifies the effect delegates to the cascade service with exact parameters. Mock verification is the appropriate assertion type for effect classes whose primary responsibility is coordinating calls to injected services. Low maintenance, meaningful wiring contract.

test_intent: Verify that when isSilentMode is true, RequireAiAnalysisEffect passes the silent mode flag through to IAiCascadeService.HandleAiCascadeAnalysisAsync.
reason: Tests a specific parameter variation (silent mode=true) through the effect delegation. Complements the base test by covering a distinct behavioral path. Clean mock verification at the right seam with low maintenance cost.

test_intent: Verify that when mlScore is 0.0, RequireAiAnalysisEffect passes the zero score through to IAiCascadeService.HandleAiCascadeAnalysisAsync.
reason: Tests the zero ML score boundary condition through the effect delegation. Complements the base test by covering a distinct parameter edge case. Clean mock verification at the right seam with low maintenance cost.

test_intent: Verify that AllowMessageEffect calls CheckAiDetectAndNotifyAdminsAsync and, when AI detect does not block, calls IncrementGoodMessageCountAsync with the message text.
reason: Tests the happy path of the allow effect: AI detect check followed by good message count increment. Two mock verifications confirm both the check and the increment happen. Clean unit test at the correct seam protecting a real moderation contract (tracking good messages for trusted users).

test_intent: Verify that when AI detect blocks a user, AllowMessageEffect skips calling IncrementGoodMessageCountAsync.
reason: Tests the conditional branch where AI detect blocks the user, preventing good message count increment. Uses Times.Never to verify the increment is not called. Complements the happy-path test by covering the negative branch. Protects a real moderation contract: blocked users should not accumulate trust.

test_intent: Verify that when a message has no Text but has a Caption, AllowMessageEffect uses the caption as the message text when calling IncrementGoodMessageCountAsync.
reason: Tests the caption fallback path where message text is null and caption is used instead. This is a real edge case for media messages (photos, videos) in Telegram. Clean mock verification confirms the correct string is passed to the increment call. Protects a real bot contract for handling media messages.

test_intent: Verify that BanUserEffect.ExecuteAsync calls both IUserFlowLogger.LogUserBanned and IUserBanService.AutoBanAsync with the correct parameters.
reason: Tests the core ban effect behavior: logging the ban event and executing the ban. Two mock verifications confirm both side effects happen with correct parameters. Clean unit test at the correct seam protecting a real ban-side-effect contract. This is the primary safety net for the ban effect wiring.
